svg.title: The Clasps: Clockwork cutaway
svg.desc: The Clasps (1D): a cutaway through a book cover shows a brass gear train on a five by four peg board. The crank turns the first gear clockwise and each meshing gear turns the other way, so the player is placing the last gear from the tray to make the latch gear turn clockwise and draw the bolt. A reset lever sits top left, the move counter top right, the hint sigil glows bottom right.
